envelope: The API object is a ConfigMap. apiVersion, kind and metadata are not part of this closed set. decide() sees data only.

slice_c.note: note: un-freeze signature not verified (slice C)
slice_c.extension: A frozen=false object with seq other than 0 is the unfrozen shape. This slice checks that the unfreeze fields are present and are strings. It does not verify the Owner signature, bind it to seq and frozen_at, or reject replay.

inferred: seq: the plan's freeze sequence (冻结序号). Not in the existing ConfigMap or task-release-window.yaml. String, not a number, because ConfigMap data values are strings. 0 is never frozen.
reason, who, frozen_at: the keys the existing freeze step reads. reason and frozen_at fill the refusal line. who is required so a freeze record the old step understands is not an unknown field.

unfreeze_seq, unfreeze_frozen_at, unfreeze_at, unfreeze_by, unfreeze_text, unfreeze_sig: not in this repo. Inferred from release.sh's signed line 'unfreeze frozen_at=… at=… by=…' plus the plan's rule that the signature also names the sequence. Slice C owns verification and may rename them.
The manifest k8s/cicd/release-policy/configmaps.yaml data is only frozen=false. It is missing seq, so this task refuses it until the Owner replaces it with the initial object.
